newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed in featureless trade with most traders sidelined due mainly to an absence of fresh incentives, dealers said on Tuesday.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning except for some light activity at the longer end. Some people are waiting for Wednesday's release of the U.S. consumer price report for September for more clues to market direction," a local dealer said.
"But I don't think there will be much impact here unless the figures are way off market expectations," he said.
In day-to-day rates, Tuesday/Wednesday, Wednesday/Thursday and week-fixed were unchanged from Monday's common 5-3/8 5-1/4 percent, respectively.
Among longer dates, two-months was unchanged at 5-7/16 5-5/16 percent, four-months unchanged at 5-1/2 5-3/8, six-months unchanged at 5-5/8 5-1/2 and nine-months unchanged at 5-3/4 5-5/8 percent.
